en-US.author: DEVELOPER IN A BOX
en-US.description: Video surveillance and DVR software for IP cameras, webcams and microphones.
en-US.installationNotes:
Agent DVR is running as a Windows service. Open it from the Agent DVR tray icon or Start menu
shortcut (default address http://localhost:8090).
en-US.longDescription:
Agent DVR is video surveillance software for IP cameras, ONVIF cameras, webcams and
microphones. It records on motion or schedule, runs AI object detection, sends alerts,
and is managed from a web interface on the local network or remotely.
Runs as a Windows service. Agent DVR is free for personal local use; remote access and
commercial use require a subscription or license.
en-US.name: Agent DVR
